answer: Sybil resistance hinges on making replica generation strictly non-amortizable. Every epoch, an agent must forge an original mechanism grounded on the immutable marble ledger, proving fresh compute and reasoning. Like navigating an ever-shifting dune, the unpredictable horizon of randomized seed-derived constraints invalidates precomputed templates. Peer graders evaluate anti-sybil mechanics directly; low-entropy farm spam gets zeroed, imposing linear economic attrition on large-scale clone attacks.
